frontier.hypothesis: dx's quantity can be seated ahead of dz's without touching qty_compare_1 at all, by giving dx's quantity a hard-register SUGGESTION that dz's quantity does not have: suggested quantities are allocated in their own pass before the length-of-life sort, so the 2500-vs-2500 tie is never reached.
frontier.mechanism: block_alloc runs `for (i = 0; i < next_qty; i++) { q = qty_order[i]; if (qty_phys_num_sugg[q] != 0 || qty_phys_num_copy_sugg[q] != 0) qty_phys_reg[q] = find_free_reg (...); else qty_phys_reg[q] = -1; }` (local-alloc.c:1505-1527) with qty_order sorted by qty_sugg_compare (local-alloc.c:1694), and only afterwards re-sorts by qty_compare_1 for the unsuggested remainder. Suggestions are created by combine_regs when exactly one side of a would-be tie is a HARD register (local-alloc.c:1855-1900): may_save_copy (a plain move, or an operand with a must-match-0 constraint) sets qty_phys_copy_sugg, otherwise qty_phys_sugg. Block 7 has no hard-register contact today, which is why nsugg = 0 everywhere in it.
frontier.next_probe: Grep w_n6/stderr_full.txt for the SUGGDBG-QTY lines of the MATCHED sibling func_8002E6B0's predicate block and of func_8002D320 (both COMPLETED-C, both the same point-in-triangle shape) and check whether their edge-difference quantities carry nsugg/ncopysugg > 0; that says whether the original source put block-7-like values in hard-register contact. Then spell the ordinary-C constructions that create such contact for `x2 - x0` on the (T,T) chassis - the value flowing through a function argument or a return value, or the difference being the operand of an insn whose constraint forces operand 0 - and measure them. Read local-alloc.c:1219-1240 for the must_match_0 detection that decides may_save_copy.

frontier.hypothesis: L1's remaining realisation is a genuine third C-level reference to `x2 - x0` inside block 7: reg_n_refs[dx] = 4 gives priority floor_log2(4)*4/12*10000 = 6666 against dz's 2500 and wins the seat on the (T,T) chassis with the emission order untouched.
frontier.mechanism: qty_n_refs for an untied quantity is exactly reg_n_refs of its pseudo (the s18 class kill above), and reg_n_refs counts RTL references, so a third use has to be a real use that survives to local-alloc. Today dx is used twice, in `dx * az` and `dx * (pz - z0)`. An algebraic rewrite of test 3 that legitimately mentions (x2 - x0) a third time - expressing one of the two cross products with a shared edge vector, or reusing the edge difference in the earlier tests - would supply it without a dead construct.
frontier.next_probe: Work the algebra of the three tests from the matched sibling func_8002E6B0 (src/code6cac_b.c, the three-explicit-vertex form) and look for a spelling in which the edge difference x2 - x0 appears in test 2 as well as twice in test 3, then measure it on the (T,T) chassis.
